_comment: Known drift per frame/case: the harness fails when a case gets worse than this (plus slack: 2.0% pixels, 1.0 px bounds, 0.5 px font). Regenerate with -PvitroParityUpdateBaseline=true; keep or write each "reason". An update records regressions too: read the diff before committing it, and keep the entries of cases with an open regression. #794 empties this file.

mirror/area.reason: Vitro draws a 48 px compact header row (name + a sofa icon, not the area's own stove icon) where HA draws its default picture-less area card: a 120 px icon hero over a name row; card ~130 px shorter, name 16 vs 14 px (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/auto-entities.reason: the entities card inside matches row for row, but Vitro's rows are 48 vs HA's 56 px apart and the cover buttons sit closer together, so the card is ~25 px shorter (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/clock-date.reason: the date line and layout match HA (its start cut off at the large size, as HA's marquee rests); what is left is glyph antialiasing on the 64 px digits and 24 px date, just over the 2% line

mirror/entity.reason: value, unit and icon match; the card is ~18 px shorter (HA's entity card keeps more bottom padding under the value) (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/entity-filter.reason: the wrapped entities card loses its title ("Lights off") and header toggle, and rows show the bare entity name ("Window") where HA prefixes the device ("LED Strip Window"); card ~50 px shorter (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/gauge.reason: arc thinner and ~15% smaller, its track lighter grey than HA's near-black, the 74% value smaller and drawn on canvas (missing text), card ~27 px shorter (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/gauge-needle.reason: needle and severity bands ignored: Vitro draws one green value arc with no red/yellow segments and no needle; same smaller arc, value and ~27 px shorter card as the plain gauge (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/horizontal-stack.reason: the stack itself matches; the two button cards show the bare entity name ("Window", "Sunset") where HA prefixes the device ("LED Strip Window", "Sunset Lamp Sunset") (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/layout-card.reason: the 2x2 grid of tiles is laid out, but its column gap and margins differ: Vitro's tiles start ~10 px higher and right of HA's and the card is ~24 px off (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/light-off.reason: a different card: Vitro draws a half-width, ~160 px tall tile (small dial, icon in a disc, name + "Off"); HA's card is full width, ~260 px tall, a large dial around the entity icon, a more-info button, device-prefixed name and no state line (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/light-on.reason: a different card: for this on/off-only light HA draws no dial, just a large yellow bulb, a more-info button and the name; Vitro draws a half-width tile with a full brightness ring and "On" (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/markdown-cardmod.reason: harness limit: Robolectric's Skia draws Inter's default instance and ignores its wght/opsz axes, so the 56 px weight-300 h1 renders regular and its line box differs (Humidity 2 px higher, card ~2.5 px off). On the panels Inter's axes apply: the Vitro Glass clock's light digits draw like HA's on the tablet and the S1 (2026-11-24)

mirror/markdown-cardmod-has.reason: the sheet applies as in HA (:host centering, ha-card:has() tint, green heading, 18 px bold paragraph). Left: Vitro sizes Markdown runs in whole device px (AbsoluteSizeSpan), so the 16.38 px h3 draws at 16.5-16.67 (fractional sizes tried 2026-11-24: font deltas 0 but no pixel gain, markdown-table worse); the 18 px line sits 0.85-1.35 px lower and the card 0.3-0.5 px taller; Android's Roboto against the frontend's web Roboto. The report's +4.5 px on "text." is not Vitro: HA's run box starts at the space before it

mirror/media-control.reason: a different design: HA's idle card is a filled accent-blue block with placeholder art, a large play button and browse/source icons; Vitro draws a dark card with prev/play/next, "Idle" and a volume slider, ~37 px taller (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-alarm.reason: the arm buttons row (home, away) is missing, so the card is 64 px shorter; the disarmed icon is a green outline shield where HA's is a filled blue shield-off on a blue disc (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-climate.reason: not drawn as a Mushroom card: Vitro shows only a centered "AC" and a menu button; no icon, no "Heat - 19.5 °C" state, no -/22.0/+ temperature row or mode button; 64 px shorter (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-cover.reason: show_buttons_control ignored: the up/stop/down row is missing (64 px shorter); icon purple without a disc where HA's is blue on a blue disc (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-fan.reason: show_percentage_control ignored: the green 20% slider is missing (64 px shorter); the on icon is teal without a disc where HA's is green on a green disc (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-light-off.reason: show_brightness_control ignored: the brightness slider row is missing, 64 px shorter (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-number.reason: the slider row is missing, 64 px shorter; header (icon, name, 22.0 °C) matches (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-select.reason: the option dropdown row and the secondary state line ("open") are missing, so the name centers alone in a 64 px shorter card (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-title.reason: title 16 vs 24 px and subtitle 13 vs 16 px, with less top padding: the text sits ~25 px higher than HA's (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-vacuum.reason: commands ignored: the start/return buttons row is missing (64 px shorter); state shows "sleeping" (an attribute) where HA shows "Docked", and a vacuum icon where HA's docked icon is zzz (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/picture.reason: wrong size: Vitro draws the image at half the column width, cropped to a short banner, where HA draws it full width at its natural square aspect; card ~362 px off (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/picture-elements.reason: image and positions match; the state icon sits on a dark disc and the state label on a dark pill that HA doesn't draw, label 12 vs 14 px (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/picture-glance.reason: the same picture sizing as `picture` (half width, cropped banner vs full-width square), ~362 px off; the title bar and entity icons are there (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/thermostat.reason: the dial's texts (Off, 17.5 °C) are drawn on its canvas, so the harness can't find them as text runs; pixels 0.2%

mirror/weather-current.reason: icon ~30% smaller, condition and temperature 22 vs 24 px, 76% 12 vs 14 px with no humidity drop icon, card ~37 px shorter (HA pads more) (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)
